mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE del_flag = '0') as total_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE status = 2 AND del_flag = '0') as certified_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE status = 1 AND del_flag = '0') as pending_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM supplier_cert WHERE status = 0 AND del_flag = '0') as rejected_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_input WHERE del_flag = '0') as total_inputs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_input WHERE type = '0' AND del_flag = '0') as seed_inputs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_input WHERE type = '1' AND del_flag = '0') as fertilizer_inputs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_input WHERE type = '2' AND del_flag = '0') as pesticide_inputs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE del_flag = '0') as total_warehouses, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(capacity), 0) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE del_flag = '0') as total_capacity, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_quantity), 0) FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0') as used_capacity, CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE del_flag = '0') > 0 THEN ROUND((SELECT SUM(current_quantity) FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0') * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM inv_warehouse WHERE del_flag = '0'), 2) ELSE 0 END as capacity_usage_rate, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_quantity), 0) FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0') as total_stock_quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_inventory WHERE stock_status = '0' AND del_flag = '0') as normal_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_inventory WHERE stock_status = '1' AND del_flag = '0') as near_expiry_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_inventory WHERE stock_status = '2' AND del_flag = '0') as expired_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_stock_in WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND del_flag = '0') as today_stock_in_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_stock_out WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND del_flag = '0') as today_stock_out_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sii.quantity), 0) FROM inv_stock_in si LEFT JOIN inv_stock_in_item sii ON si.stock_in_id = sii.stock_in_id WHERE YEAR(si.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(si.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND si.status = '1' AND si.del_flag = '0') as month_stock_in_quantity, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) FROM inv_stock_out so LEFT JOIN inv_stock_out_item soi ON so.stock_out_id = soi.stock_out_id WHERE YEAR(so.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(so.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND so.status = '1' AND so.del_flag = '0') as month_stock_out_quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_inventory WHERE stock_status IN ('1', '2') AND del_flag = '0') as pending_warnings

SELECT sc.user_id, sc.org_name, sc.status, sc.contact_name, sc.contact_phone, sc.approve_time, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.input_id) as product_count, COALESCE(si_stats.month_count, 0) as month_stock_in_count, COALESCE(si_stats.month_quantity, 0) as month_stock_in_quantity, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), sc.approve_time) as cooperation_days FROM ( SELECT sc1.* FROM supplier_cert sc1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(create_time) as max_create_time FROM supplier_cert WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) sc2 ON sc1.user_id = sc2.user_id AND sc1.create_time = sc2.max_create_time WHERE sc1.del_flag = '0' AND sc1.status = 2 ) sc LEFT JOIN supplier_product sp ON sc.user_id = sp.supplier_id AND sp.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT supplier_id, COUNT(*) as month_count, COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as month_quantity FROM ( SELECT si.supplier_id, si.stock_in_id, COALESCE(SUM(sii.quantity), 0) as total_qty FROM inv_stock_in si LEFT JOIN inv_stock_in_item sii ON si.stock_in_id = sii.stock_in_id WHERE YEAR(si.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(si.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND si.status = '1' AND si.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY si.supplier_id, si.stock_in_id ) tmp GROUP BY supplier_id ) si_stats ON sc.user_id = si_stats.supplier_id GROUP BY sc.user_id, sc.org_name, sc.status, sc.contact_name, sc.contact_phone, sc.approve_time ORDER BY month_stock_in_quantity DESC, product_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ai.input_id, ai.input_name, ai.type, ai.input_sku, COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) as current_stock, COALESCE(si_stats.month_quantity, 0) as month_stock_in, COALESCE(so_stats.month_quantity, 0) as month_stock_out, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(so_stats.month_quantity, 0) * 100.0 / inv.current_stock, 2) ELSE 0 END as turnover_rate, COALESCE(sp_count.supplier_count, 0) as supplier_count, inv.stock_status, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status IN ('1', '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as warning_flag FROM agri_input ai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT input_id, SUM(current_quantity) as current_stock, MAX(stock_status) as stock_status FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY input_id ) inv ON ai.input_id = inv.input_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sii.input_id, SUM(sii.quantity) as month_quantity FROM inv_stock_in_item sii INNER JOIN inv_stock_in si ON sii.stock_in_id = si.stock_in_id WHERE YEAR(si.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(si.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND si.status = '1' AND si.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY sii.input_id ) si_stats ON ai.input_id = si_stats.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT soi.product_id, SUM(soi.quantity) as month_quantity FROM inv_stock_out_item soi INNER JOIN inv_stock_out so ON soi.stock_out_id = so.stock_out_id WHERE YEAR(so.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(so.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND so.status = '1' AND so.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY soi.product_id ) so_stats ON ai.input_id = so_stats.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT input_id, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id) as supplier_count FROM supplier_product WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY input_id ) sp_count ON ai.input_id = sp_count.input_id WHERE ai.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY month_stock_out DESC, current_stock DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, CONCAT('WH', LPAD(w.warehouse_id, 6, '0')) as warehouse_code, w.location, w.capacity, w.belongs, sc.org_name as supplier_name, COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) as current_stock, CASE WHEN w.capacity > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) * 100.0 / w.capacity, 2) ELSE 0 END as usage_rate, COALESCE(inv.product_type_count, 0) as product_type_count, COALESCE(si_count.month_count, 0) as month_stock_in_count, COALESCE(so_count.month_count, 0) as month_stock_out_count, CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv.current_stock, 0) > w.capacity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as capacity_warning FROM inv_warehouse w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sc1.* FROM supplier_cert sc1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(create_time) as max_create_time FROM supplier_cert WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) sc2 ON sc1.user_id = sc2.user_id AND sc1.create_time = sc2.max_create_time WHERE sc1.del_flag = '0' ) sc ON w.supplier_id = sc.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(current_quantity) as current_stock, COUNT(DISTINCT input_id) as product_type_count FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY warehouse_id ) inv ON w.warehouse_id = inv.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) as month_count FROM inv_stock_in WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND status = '1' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY warehouse_id ) si_count ON w.warehouse_id = si_count.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warehouse_id, COUNT(*) as month_count FROM inv_stock_out WHERE YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND status = '1' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY warehouse_id ) so_count ON w.warehouse_id = so_count.warehouse_id WHERE w.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY usage_rate DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_list.date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(si_stats.stock_in_quantity, 0) as stock_in_quantity, COALESCE(si_stats.stock_in_count, 0) as stock_in_count, COALESCE(so_stats.stock_out_quantity, 0) as stock_out_quantity, COALESCE(so_stats.stock_out_count, 0) as stock_out_count, (COALESCE(si_stats.stock_in_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(so_stats.stock_out_quantity, 0)) as net_stock_change FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) as date FROM ( SELECT 0 as n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 ) nums WHERE n < #{days} ) date_list LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(si.create_time) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT si.stock_in_id) as stock_in_count, COALESCE(SUM(sii.quantity), 0) as stock_in_quantity FROM inv_stock_in si LEFT JOIN inv_stock_in_item sii ON si.stock_in_id = sii.stock_in_id WHERE si.status = '1' AND si.del_flag = '0' AND si.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(si.create_time) ) si_stats ON date_list.date = si_stats.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(so.create_time) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT so.stock_out_id) as stock_out_count, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) as stock_out_quantity FROM inv_stock_out so LEFT JOIN inv_stock_out_item soi ON so.stock_out_id = soi.stock_out_id WHERE so.status = '1' AND so.del_flag = '0' AND so.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(so.create_time) ) so_stats ON date_list.date = so_stats.date ORDER BY date_list.date ASC

SELECT ai.type, CASE ai.type WHEN '0' THEN '种子' WHEN '1' THEN '化肥' WHEN '2' THEN '农药' ELSE '其他' END as type_name, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(inv.stock_quantity), 0) as stock_quantity, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agri_input WHERE del_flag = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM agri_input ai LEFT JOIN ( SELECT input_id, SUM(current_quantity) as stock_quantity FROM inv_inventory WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY input_id ) inv ON ai.input_id = inv.input_id WHERE ai.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY ai.type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONCAT('W', inv.inventory_id) as warning_id, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status = '1' THEN '1' WHEN inv.stock_status = '2' THEN '2' END as warning_type, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status = '1' THEN '临期预警' WHEN inv.stock_status = '2' THEN '过期预警' END as warning_type_desc, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status = '2' THEN 3 WHEN inv.stock_status = '1' THEN 2 END as warning_level, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status = '2' THEN '高' WHEN inv.stock_status = '1' THEN '中' END as warning_level_desc, '1' as object_type, CAST(inv.input_id AS CHAR) as object_id, ai.input_name as object_name, CASE WHEN inv.stock_status = '1' THEN CONCAT('投入品"', ai.input_name, '"即将过期,剩余', DATEDIFF(inv.expired_date, CURDATE()), '天') WHEN inv.stock_status = '2' THEN CONCAT('投入品"', ai.input_name, '"已过期,超期', DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), inv.expired_date), '天') END as warning_content, CONCAT(inv.current_quantity, '件') as current_value, '30天' as threshold, inv.update_time as warning_time, '0' as status, w.warehouse_name, inv.batch_no FROM inv_inventory inv INNER JOIN agri_input ai ON inv.input_id = ai.input_id AND ai.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN inv_warehouse w ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id AND w.del_flag = '0' WHERE inv.stock_status IN ('1', '2') AND inv.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY warning_level DESC, inv.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
